ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; the visible ventral surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized edge highlights and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-level mapping shows a uniform low-intensity dark field; distinct high-contrast contiguous blobs of high-intensity pixels are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated acute vertex angle of approximately 70 degrees relative to the lobar baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration map; contains high pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) across the entire boundary, with a deep irregular void observed on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is convex from the median notch, transitioning to a distinct upward concave sweep at the lateral termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large jagged indentation/excision on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive irregular serration across both trailing edges suggesting repetitive physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward-curling 'hooked' morphology at the lateral extremities of the fluke lobes.
